plugins.name: outrider-recon
plugins.description: Claude-native, governed offensive-OSINT and external attack-surface platform for authorized security teams: multi-agent recon across web/API, identity, cloud, secrets, and people/breach intelligence, with deterministic scope, evidence, and approval controls, a governed agent-to-agent orchestrator, and human-reviewed findings for hand-off to validation and pen-testing. It is not an exploitation framework and does not perform intrusive testing.
